# Agents

Serve the model operations to an assistant.

## naga mcp

```text
usage: naga mcp [-h] [--root ROOT] [--allow-network] [--allow-private-network]
                [--allow-host HOST] [--connections FILE]
                [--tools {all,compact}] [--twin DIR]

Run the MCP server over stdio. File access is confined to --root, and network
access is off unless you allow it here.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           workspace root: the only directory models may be read
                        from or written to (default: the current directory)
  --allow-network       permit sql / json_url data sources (refused by
                        default: opening a model must not make outbound
                        connections on its own)
  --allow-private-network
                        also permit private/intranet addresses (refused even
                        with --allow-network)
  --allow-host HOST     restrict network sources to this hostname; may repeat
  --connections FILE    the connections a live source (rest, mqtt, opcua) may
                        name: a JSON file of yours, never the model's; without
                        it every live source is refused
  --tools {all,compact}
                        all: every tool (default); compact: only what
                        building, running and saving a model needs
                        (get_model_format, write_model, run_model, ...), so a
                        client pays for fewer tool descriptions
  --twin DIR            the result directory of a twin you started (naga twin
                        run --out DIR): two read-only tools then answer from
                        it. No tool can start a twin or choose this directory
```

## naga assist

```text
usage: naga assist [-h] [--provider {anthropic,openai}] [--base-url BASE_URL]
                   [--model-id MODEL_ID]
                   [--reasoning {none,low,medium,high,omit}]
                   [--max-tool-rounds MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS]
                   model prompt

Run one assistant turn against a model file, with a local model or your own
API key.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model .json file, or a bundled model's
                        name (naga examples)
  prompt                what to ask the assistant to do

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --provider {anthropic,openai}
                        anthropic, or openai for any OpenAI-compatible server
                        (Ollama, LM Studio); default: anthropic when
                        ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else a local Ollama
  --base-url BASE_URL   default http://localhost:11434/v1
  --model-id MODEL_ID   the provider's model name (for Ollama, one from
                        `ollama list`)
  --reasoning {none,low,medium,high,omit}
  --max-tool-rounds MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS
```
